statement: 长任务或媒体输出先写入受控 staging/temporary 位置，经真实解析与完整性检查后再复制/发布到用户目标；FFmpeg return code 或 progress=100% 不是持久成功的充分条件。

scope.notes: Conservative Claim model of Experimental catalog record REL.VERIFY_THEN_PUBLISH; support threshold intentionally exceeds current independent evidence by one group.

review.rationale: Evidence-insufficient Experimental record modeled without promotion; additional independent evidence is required by policy.
